key_idea: Two adjacent columns can never both contain stems (their caps would collide), and a stemless column receives at most two tiles, the side caps of its two neighbours, so only r<=2 or c=1 is possible.
sketch: c=1: a single stem column gives 1 for any r. r=1: a mushroom whose cap row is the target row covers 3 consecutive cells, so ceil(c/3). r=2: every stemless column needs both neighbours with cap heights k and k+1, so columns alternate stem/empty with alternating heights; starting with a stem gives floor(c/2)+1 mushrooms. r>=3 and c>=2: -1. O(1). Pitfall: forgetting c=1 before the r>=3 rejection, and that r=2,c=2 needs 2.
